title: F148 the docs in layers: from the front door down to one decision
caption: Five layers, read top down: each layer links down to the next and back up to its index, and every kind of doc has its own template.

cards.title: 1. The front door
cards.text: What it is, where it is going, what is next. 3 docs at the root.

cards.title: 2. The index and the standing pages
cards.text: Every doc by kind, and the pages that always hold: GOAL, SETUP, MODELS, the work log, the development guide. 7 docs.

cards.title: 3. The whole
cards.text: How the parts fit, across projects. Kind: explanation. 13 docs.

cards.title: 4. One project
cards.text: A design doc per project. Kind: project. 34 docs.

cards.title: 4. Doing one job
cards.text: A how-to per job on a project. Kind: how-to. 23 docs.

cards.title: 5. Why
cards.text: One decision each. Kind: ADR. 114 docs.

cards.title: 5. What it taught
cards.text: A write-up per skill, and a lesson per fix. Kinds: write-up, lesson. 14 docs.

cards.title: 5. Being built
cards.text: Kinds: plan, feature doc, fix doc. Deleted when the work is done.

cards.title: The same layers 3 to 5, in two areas
cards.text: src/docs (the framework) · packs/docs (the packs). The demos' docs are out of scope for now.
